segments.text:
V. 47.
Beginning at Jeruſalem—This was appointed both graciouſly and wiſely: Graciouſly as it encouraged the greateſt Sinners to repent when they ſaw that even the Murderers of Chriſt were not excepted from Mercy: And wiſely, as hereby Chriſtianity was more abundantly atteſted; the Facts being publiſhed firſt, on the very Spot where they happened.
